$comment: Block 9 step 2.3. Every codec contribution under extensions/common/** must appear here exactly once with exactly one status: compared-real, compared-synthetic, not-comparable-no-canonical-probe, not-comparable-contract-difference or blocked-missing-legal-corpus. scripts/test/parity-coverage.test.ts fails when a contribution is added, removed or renamed without updating this table, and a declared reason never counts as a pass.

coverage.reason: The canonical codec delegates every read to the 7-Zip WASM bridge and throws "7z support is not initialised" until a host supplies the blob; the canonical checkout vendors no such blob, so no canonical read plane can be observed without shipping one.

The canonical RTF support renders a display view model of document blocks and recovers no source text, while X3 publishes a structural tree and byte range. No plane is defined the same way on both sides, so any count-to-count verdict would be manufactured.
The repository corpus carries no TSV sample and Block 9 step 2 forbids hand-crafting one; the canonical document family exposes no TSV format either, so neither side has an input to compare.

The canonical checkout publishes no codec for this format: its document family covers csv, docx, markdown, pdf, rtf, txt and office containers only, and XML/JSON exist there as internal parser libraries rather than as an openable subject. Comparing against the generic txt document codec would invent a plane the canonical never claims.
